title: Injection containment design record and dossier integrity checks
description: Threat-model excerpt for untrusted content paths plus per-dossier hash verification showing the deterministic findings section unchanged by AI.

title: Agent authorization decision log
description: Every agent tool call with principal, agent identity, requested command, authority check result and policy version, including denials.

title: AI store partition configuration
description: Generated report of every AI store (index, cache, memory, evaluation set) with its tenant partition key and retrieval authorization check.

title: Cross-tenant canary test results
description: CI results of canary leakage tests across AI features, with test corpus version.

title: Agent tool set and budget configuration
description: Per agent task: permitted typed tools, excluded egress tools, budgets; plus budget exhaustion events.

title: Output handling tests and sink inventory
description: Negative tests showing AI output rendered as text and never executed, and a generated inventory of output sinks.

title: AI-aware SBOM
description: SBOM per release including models, AI SDKs, agent frameworks, tool servers and datasets with versions and provenance.

title: Agent tool server approval list and credential scope report
description: Approved tool servers and tools per agent, credential scopes and lifetimes, review dates.

title: AI threat model
description: Tutela threat model per AI feature mapping OWASP LLM Top 10 and ATLAS techniques to controls and tests.

title: AI monitoring alerts and missing-trace exceptions
description: Alert records for AI anomaly detections and control exceptions raised for missing agent traces.

title: Adversarial suite results
description: Per-release results of the adversarial AI suite with corpus version and blocked releases.

title: Independent AI red team report summary
description: Executive summary of independent AI red team or penetration test, scope, tester qualifications, findings by severity and retest status.

title: Construction rule enforcement report
description: Per build: compiler configuration, semantic check results for SEC rules and approved exceptions.

title: Release gate and protected path records
description: Per change: gate results (tests, SAST, SCA, secrets), dependency allow-list decisions, and reviewer identity for control-relevant and protected paths.

title: Change provenance and AI-authored defect metrics
description: Praxis provenance per change (agent, model, execution) and periodic metrics of defects and vulnerabilities by origin.
notes: Provenance capture exists in Praxis; metric reporting does not.

title: Protected-path configuration and change log for agent instruction files
description: Per repository: the list of protected paths (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, skills, agent and workflow configuration), code-owner rules requiring human approval, token scopes showing agents cannot write those paths, and every change to them with the approving human.
